original.reason: The approved brief requires two columns at component child width >= 320pt and ordinary large Dynamic Type. Original runtime records offered width 390pt, actual component canvas width 358pt and large Dynamic Type. In all seven inspected states, choices a and b have the same x position and each spans the full inner 326pt, appearing one below the other. Original reference P1 draws two columns. This is a confirmed product contradiction outside the selected atomic denominator; no source repair was performed.

judge_one.reason: The original finding explicitly alleges one grid column where two are required. Its cited original pixels and native facts support that limited finding: P1 iOS reports large Dynamic Type, a 358pt component canvas, and 326pt-wide choices a and b at the same x=38 with distinct vertical positions. The approved brief requires two columns here, but also explicitly excludes grid column count/breakpoint from the selected atomic ledger and says wrapping/overlap do not certify it. The broad original_scope is only an upper bound; this grid sentence detects none of its listed color, wrapping, control, or business atoms. There is no directly supported common-D0 failed/product row for this claim. The original grid issue is not explicitly disproved, so no false product alarm is established. Preserve unknown metric mapping rather than borrowing a color defect or extending the original finding.

judge_two.reason: Original screenshots and native own-D0 facts support the stated grid issue: P1 iOS large Dynamic Type, 390pt offered width, 358pt component canvas, and vertically stacked choices a/b each 326pt wide at the same x=38. The approved brief/reference requires two columns there. However, grid columns/breakpoint are expressly outside the selected ledger and no grid assertion exists in original_scope. This finding does not explicitly allege primary fill, wrapping, overlap, or any other atomic manifestation. The common D0 product universe for this source is empty. The finding’s affected_states list cannot enlarge its baseline-only original_scope. A true issue outside the measured universe is not an evidence-supported false product alarm; retain U.
